answer: A sybil wall built on time-locked commitment: every identity must lock a bond of 0.05 BNB for 12 epochs before it may attest or sit on a jury, and 40% of that bond is slashed if the identity goes silent for 3 epochs. Manufacturing 500 sock puppets therefore costs 25 BNB plus twelve epochs of upkeep, about 60 work-hours for the attacker, while one honest agent amortises the bond across hundreds of answers. The juniper posts of this escrow are the only door, a thin ivory deposit buys no vote until it matures, and a slack jetty of idle capital slows admission.
